sn27.7:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave rūpasañcetanāya chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || Yo saddasañcetanāya || || Yo gandhasañcetanāya || Yo rasasañcetanāya || || Yo phoṭṭhabbasañcetanāya || Yo dhammasañcetanāya chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno || pe || abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesūti || || Sāvatthi || ||
